description: This Java class 'BackgroundSyncStream' manages the process of detecting inconsistencies between persisted metadata and search index metadata for 'things'. It merges streams of metadata, compares entries, and triggers updates for out-of-date or missing entries, with support for policy revision checks and throttling.

classes.name: BackgroundSyncStream
classes.description: Manages merging and comparison of metadata streams to identify and trigger updates for inconsistent 'thing' metadata entries.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new BackgroundSyncStream with specified parameters.

methods.name: filterForInconsistencies
methods.description: Merges metadata streams and filters for inconsistencies, emitting entries that need updating.

methods.name: isInsideToleranceWindow
methods.description: Checks if a metadata's modification time is within the tolerance window.

methods.name: dummyMetadata
methods.description: Creates a dummy Metadata object used as a placeholder.

methods.name: filterForInconsistency
methods.description: Determines if a pair of metadata entries are inconsistent and returns appropriate sources for updates.

methods.name: confirmPersistedAndNotIndexed
methods.description: Triggers update for persisted but not indexed metadata outside the tolerance window.

methods.name: emitUnlessConsistent
methods.description: Emits a metadata entry if there is a discrepancy in revision or policy ID.

methods.name: retainUnlessPolicyNonexistent
methods.description: Checks if a persisted metadata's policy exists before deciding to update.

methods.name: retrievePolicyRevisionAndEmitMismatch
methods.description: Retrieves policy revision and emits mismatch if revisions differ.

methods.name: compareMetadata
methods.description: Compares two Metadata objects based on their ThingId.

methods.name: compareThingIds
methods.description: Compares two ThingId objects, considering dummy status and natural order.
